cues: Gibberellin was found through a rice disease.
In bakanae, the foolish seedling disease, infected rice grows absurdly tall and pale, then falls over.
In nineteen twenty-six Kurosawa showed that a cell-free extract of the fungus Gibberella fujikuroi did the same thing.
The active substance was gibberellic acid.
